title: Biological Activity Studies on a Copper(II) Complex with Taurine Schiff Base

sections.abstract: <jats:p>A new material of copper(II) complex (complex 1) with taurine Schiff base has been synthesized and characterized by elemental analysis, ESI-MS and IR spectra. 1 was tested against HepG2 cell lines with IC50 values of 12.89 μM. With the concentrations of 1 increasing, the population of apoptosis was 1.28% for 0 μM, 24.4% for 10 μM and 47.9% for 20μM, and the population of G2 phase was 19.2% for 0 μM, 34.4% for 10 μM and 42.9% for 20μM, respectively. 1 showed significant cytotoxic activity against HepG2 cell lines.</jats:p>
